attachment/None.why: Post-answer attachment rows in the linux host corpus are an interactive harness (entrypoint cli or sdk-cli; p50 74 ms, p95 326 s, max days). A minified 2.1.232 Path B cell on this host emits type=attachment (total_tokens_reminder) only BEFORE the assistant, on mint and again after /clear. Sizing the drain to the interactive tail would be sizing it against hooks and files the minified cell does not have

system/turn_duration.why: the end-of-turn marker Claude Code writes for every turn

corpus.note: Host-local operator transcripts. Not committed: they contain prompts. The receipt is the durable artifact; re-run the tool to regenerate it.

recommendation_basis.statistic: max of every post-answer arrival a minified cell can produce, POOLED over every version measured

repromotion_triggers_this_tool_detects.reachable_arrival_above_the_bound: exit 4 when --bound-ms is given and a reachable arrival exceeds it; exit 5 when there was nothing to check
repromotion_triggers_this_tool_detects.unclassified_transcript_row_kind: exit 2 on a post-answer row kind absent from ROW_KINDS, exit 3 on a `retrospective` kind stamped after the terminal candidate

what_would_invalidate_it: an assistant row arriving after a turn's final assistant row -- see ROW_KINDS
any reachable arrival above the recommended value
a different os or arch, or a claude_version outside the promoted range
a minified cell acquiring a harness able to inject rows (a hook, a queue, an MCP server)
